name: metal_bands
label: Metal and rock bands
provenance: Recalled from general knowledge of heavy metal and hard rock across NWOBHM, thrash, death, doom, black, power, progressive, metalcore, grunge and stoner scenes; stylised punctuation was normalised (AC/DC to ACDC, Guns N Roses) and gratuitously violent or slur-adjacent band names were deliberately excluded. Not cross-checked against Encyclopaedia Metallum in this session.
